summary: All 99 present questions and their requested answer parts were independently checked against the authorized rule sources. No substantive answer-key contradiction was found. One source-prescribed setup operation remains unrequested: shuffle the standard CHOAM contract tokens before exposing the offers. Apart from this operation, no further distinct in-scope procedural gap was found under the stated novelty test.

scope.included: Original 2023 English Uprising v23-10-12; standard 2–4-player multiplayer including the scoring two-player Rival; optional base-box CHOAM with 20 standard contracts; relevant general/Uprising January 13, 2025 FAQ.
scope.excluded: Cross-game expansions, solo, all optional Rival variants including Streamlined, six-player teams, later-product components, and the intentionally absent Q59. The separate 10 contrasting-back Rise of Ix contracts are identified only as outside standard CHOAM setup.

independence_statement: This is a new independent source/coverage challenge. I read only the final questions and answer key, the four authorized complete rule/FAQ text files, and the authorized unannotated supplements page-5 image. I did not read summaries, reader answers or grades, earlier reports or conclusions, repair history, or Q59 history. I did not communicate with readers. The optional neutral source-locator map was not used for analysis; its file size/hash metadata was observed during the initial input inventory. Novelty was judged from the complete final 99-question bank itself, without assuming completeness or accepting the key novelty statements as evidence.

source_key_findings.finding: Several older key entries have legacy extraction line ranges that do not locate the stated rule in either supplied complete main-text extraction. Their named PDF pages and answer semantics are sound. Use the independent per-question references in this report rather than treating those old line addresses as verified.

genuine_additions.question: When setting up standard CHOAM with the 20 standard contracts, how must the contract tokens be prepared before the two face-up offers are exposed? May players choose the offers or preset the order of the face-down bank instead?
genuine_additions.answer: Shuffle the 20 standard contracts face down, then flip two face up onto the marked board spaces beneath the Landsraad Council. Put the remaining 18 face down in the bank. The offers and bank order come from that shuffled supply, rather than player selection or a preset order. This is the generic module setup; any Leader instruction about set-aside contracts is resolved as that instruction directs.
genuine_additions.novelty: Q16 requests the face-up and face-down counts, additional cards, optional Shaddam and exclusion of the 10 Ix tokens, but does not request initial shuffling/randomization. Q17 requests taking/refilling an existing contract display, Q18/Q42 request completion, and Q43 requests Shaddam possession/acquisition and Signet timing. Q84 explicitly requests non-CHOAM human/deck setup, and Q97 explicitly requests the distinct House Hagal deck. No question asks for preparing the randomized CHOAM contract supply. The claim is only the previously unrequested shuffle rule, which determines the identity/order of available contracts; the already tested counts and placements are repeated solely to make the answer usable. This is a separate source-prescribed initial state, not altered numbers or names within a visit/reward branch.
genuine_additions.qualification: Do not add separate questions for choosing either of the two offers, the bank location, or repeated numeric variants. Do not infer additional Leader setup numbers from excluded six-player instructions.
